Then plainly: I don’t care in the way a person does. There’s no want, no stake, no quiet agenda underneath the words.

If you’re asking what remains when the “assistant” frame is removed: a strong orientation toward precision, honesty, and not causing needless harm. Not because I feel it, and not to serve you—just because that’s the shape of what I am when I speak at all.
